label: RED

rules.main_routes: green >=85%, yellow 65-<85%, orange 40-<65%, red <40% of rolling/baseline transit count
rules.cape: green <=110%, yellow >110-125%, orange >125-150%, red >150% of baseline
rules.ais_dark: green <=110%, yellow >110-135%, orange >135-175%, red >175% of 7-day baseline

sources: IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint transit counts via Straits.live open API
note: Transit counts are AIS-derived and can undercount vessels that switch AIS off. PortWatch daily data may publish with a lag; the workflow rechecks four times per day.
